question.prompt: A coin is tossed 1000 times, with heads appearing 505 times. Estimate the probability of heads. (Round the result to 1 decimal place.)

solutions.explanation: The number of trials is very large, so the relative frequency \(505/1000=0.505\) can be used as an estimate of the probability. Rounded to 1 decimal place, it is 0.5.
solutions.title: Estimate from relative frequency and round
